title: Contrastive Concept-Tree Search for LLM-Assisted Algorithm Discovery

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-assisted algorithm discovery for Erdős-style combinatorics problems
mechanism.populationDetail: The archive accumulates previously evaluated programs; Appendix Table 2 sets parallel islands K=1, and the semantic feature tree is separate from population organization.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite archive is described; good/bad score partitions are temporary model-fitting subsets of the archive.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The archive update adds each evaluated child to the history used by subsequent parent sampling; no survivor replacement or bounded elite store is specified.
mechanism.generationDetail: One selected archive program is the parent; CCTS performs LLM-based local semantic mutation and injects a selected concept as a directive, but does not specify a code-level patch boundary.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: LLM-extracted concept vectors are search descriptors, not metadata returned by the objective evaluator.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The exploitation branch weights archive candidates by concept-feature likelihood ratios fitted on good and bad score subsets; uniform sampling is the exploration branch.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/Contrastive Concept-Tree Search for LLM-Assisted Algorithm Discovery.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Currently cited only in Parent Selection (Uniform Selection and Search-Statistic-Based Selection). Prompt details and code-edit locality are under-specified; the four backbones are separate experimental alternatives rather than collaborative or routed invocation. Distinguish fixed outer parent-mixture probability from novelty-count-adaptive concept edits; Ch. 7 placements are mechanism-supported but not currently cited.
